To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the introduction of sustainability targets leads to a decrease in the number of sustainable production units; 2) the introduction of these sustainability targets leads to an increase of sustainable efficiency of production units; 3) the introduction of new sustainability targets leads to more efficient production units; 4) the introduction of the sustainability targets leads to the production of more sustainable products.
the efficiency of the industry and the firms in it can be increased simultaneously with the sustainability of the industry and its firms.

(1) a firm's sustainable efficiency can be calculated by taking into account its own production function, the production functions of its competitors, the market price of its product, the market price for its inputs, the capacity constraints of the system, the current state of the system, and the firm's own current state, (2) sustainable efficiency is a function of the firm's own production function, (3) a firm's current efficiency and its sustainable efficiency are not necessarily equal.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to improve the efficiency of firms and the industry as a whole by removing inefficiencies, and by doing so, how to increase the sustainability of the system.
the sustainable efficiency of firms when new sustainability targets are introduced.
the question how to increase the sustainability of the economy by improving the efficiency of the firms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

a profit maximizing firm will be sustainable when it maximizes the efficiency of its production and consumption of resources, and when it maximizes its efficiency in the use of the produced goods and services.

a sustainable, profitable and efficient industry can be achieved by introducing new targets, by improving the efficiency of firms within this industry, by reducing the input of the industry and by increasing the output of the industry.
a firm’s sustainable profit maximization is a function of its sustainable efficiency improvement, its sustainable market share and the sustainable market growth of its market.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the introduction of new sustainability targets will lead to a more sustainable and efficient economy.
the introduction of new sustainability targets can be a profitable investment for firms, as long as the targets are not so strict that they cannot be met.

the sustainable efficiency of a firm depends on its own production technology, the production technologies of the other firms, the production capacity constraints, the market prices and the market shares.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the introduction of new sustainability targets will lead to a decrease in the efficiency of the firms in the industry, but will not necessarily lead to a lower profit.
there is a potential for simultaneously increasing economic growth and sustainability by improving the efficiency of firms and industries, and that this potential is not yet fully exploited.
a sustainable, profit maximization state is always possible, but that it is not necessarily the same as a state of maximum efficiency.
